simulationNotice: Roleplay is a simulation. Replies, temporary knowledge and branches do not automatically enter Canon or State.
noSessions: Choose a novel character or import a JSON character card, then create a scene to start a conversation.
editWithoutOverwrite: Editing creates a new branch and preserves the original conversation.
messagePlaceholder: Speak as your persona or ask about this scene…
startRoleplay: Start with characters and a scene
behaviorQuestion: Under which conditions would you like to analyze this character’s behavior?
memoryNotice: Choose which actors receive this temporary memory. It applies to this branch and is not a formal knowledge commit.
memoryPlaceholder: Record information actually obtained in this scene or a temporary condition confirmed by the author.
loreNotice: Audience filtering happens before keyword activation and context budgeting. Empty keywords keep an entry active for its selected audience.
publicPersona: Public introduction visible to other actors
sharedBackground: Scene background shared with participating actors
knowledgeChapter: Knowledge through committed chapter (blank uses current state)
cardImportNotice: Supports declarative JSON card fields. System prompts, scripts, extensions and remote assets do not gain execution privileges.
cardTooLarge: The character card must be no larger than 160 KB.
knowledgeInspectorNotice: This is an author inspection view. Other NPCs do not receive this actor’s full profile, private memory or reasoning.
materialNotCanon: Save the scene candidate, then create an editable material draft. It does not overwrite Final or commit story facts.
createMaterialDraft: Create material draft and open manuscript
reviewSubjective: Reviews use textual evidence and author-selected criteria. Literary judgments are subjective assistance, not objective quality proof.
noReviews: Choose a manuscript, review type and model. The original text is preserved.
criteriaPlaceholder: One criterion per line. Criteria are stored with the report and must match for comparison.
staleReview: The manuscript has changed. Recheck the evidence; this report cannot create a candidate that overwrites the current text.
unverifiedEvidence: This quotation could not be verified in the source. Automatic revision is disabled.
readerPublicOnly: The simulated reader receives the current public text and positioning only, without hidden truths, character secrets or future outlines.
reviewScopeNotice: Select only the characters, settings and references needed for this review. References do not automatically become Canon.
includeCanon: Include current Canon contract and selected character knowledge
feedbackIsolationNotice: Review findings stay in the author view. Candidates use the existing Writer-safe selection workflow rather than forwarding secret-bearing feedback.
modelComparisonNotice: Compare matching text and criteria. Different roles or runs of the same model are not independent consensus; literary opinions from multiple models are not mathematical proof.
candidateNotice: The candidate has not been applied. Review it before accepting; protected Final is preserved and accepted edits go into a separate revision draft.
maxNpcPerTurn: Select up to four NPCs per turn; other actors can respond in a later turn.
roleplayMemoryHelp: Memory needs author confirmation of audience and evidence.
budgetBlock: Block at the client reference budget
budgetEstimateNotice: Client estimates and request limits are not provider billing caps. Unknown costs or missing prices cannot guarantee a budget.
counterfactualNotice: Changes apply only to a new branch; the original world and dialogue remain intact. Start an empty conversation when changing the knowledge cutoff.
conditionalComparisonNotice: This compares declared conditions and actual dialogue, not mathematical proof or precise social forecasting.
memoryProposalHelp: AI uses only this actor’s visible scene records. Edit the proposal and confirm its audience before saving simulated memory.
budgetBlockHelp: Blocking also stops requests with unknown prices or output limits. Local estimates do not replace provider billing.
anthologyMaterialHelp: Saved as scene material. Anthologies do not create their own prose; open an individual story to continue.
unknownSuspicion: Suspicion receipt exists but safe historical wording is unavailable: UNKNOWN
